description: Per-system aliases of conventional (Hume-Rothery / intermetallic) phase names: (chemical system, printed label) -> registry identity and TDB phase per SGTE assessment, with evidence. Applied by tools/phase_label_check.py before its no-bare-Greek rule; never a global Greek -> structure rule. See tools/phase_aliases.py for the rules; the fields model_phase, tdb_phases, tdbs_without_the_phase and evidence are generated (--refresh).
rules: An alias is added only when (a) the label is used for that phase in the system's own literature / handbook (basis), (b) each listed TDB has exactly one matching independent phase with consistent composition range and structure (evidence.tdb_declarations, evidence.registry_structure; disordered parts never), and (c) at least one literature record prints the label at a consistent composition / temperature (evidence.literature_records).

Applied to a record only when every printed mole-fraction composition of the phase (or the overall composition of a one-phase value) lies in x_range +- 0.02 and a printed temperature in T_range_K +- 50 K; a formula printed in the label (ε-Cu3Sn, γ′ (Ni3Al), α(Al)) must equal the alias formula or, for an alias without one, have its composition in x_range +- 0.02.
The record's TDB (model.tdb) chooses the TDB phase name; otherwise model_phase (the name used by most assessments).

fields.label: Greek letter with prime / index as printed (ASCII ' and ’ read as ′)
fields.x_element / x_range: handbook composition range of the phase (mole fraction of x_element)
fields.registry_ids: data/phases identities that model the phase (one per naming convention)
fields.excluded_tdbs: assessments where the phase is not a unique independent phase
fields.basis: where the label is used for the phase
